name: VRM_REV_ADJ_CONTS_TEMP_ALL
description: The VRM_REV_ADJ_CONTS_TEMP_ALL table contains, for each line, contingencies that impact revenue during revenue contingency processing.

columns.name: REVENUE_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of revenue document line.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_CODE
columns.description: Contingency Code . Values are from the lookup type AR_REVENUE_CONTINGENCIES.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Contingency expiration date.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DAYS
columns.description: Contingency expiration in days.

columns.name: EXPIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the contingencies are expired on the line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: PRIMARY_REMOVAL_EVENT
columns.description: Revenue recognition event.

columns.name: ORG_ID

columns.description: Expiration event date.

columns.name: REASON_REMOVAL_DATE
columns.description: Date the contingency was expired.

columns.name: EXPIRED_BY
columns.description: Standard Who column - user who expired the contingency.

columns.name: DEFAULTED_IN_VRM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if contingencies default to invoice based on rule. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_ID
columns.description: Contingency unique identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: This column contains the comments entered by the user during the Add Revenue Contingency revenue adjustment action.
